requirement.description: The configuration parsing for VFS account permissions is failing due to incorrect handling of user accounts and group membership. Tests are failing with "invalid config" and "list of users is not comma-separated or contains invalid characters" errors when parsing configuration files.
requirement.contract: Fix the configuration parser in the AuthSrv class to properly handle account definitions in [accounts] sections and group membership in [groups] sections. The parser must validate that account names are valid and that group member lists are comma-separated with valid usernames.

requirement.description: The HTTP client is not properly handling path traversal sequences with dots. The test in test_dots.py shows that path traversal with dots like ".f6 f6 .db/.f8 .db/f8 db/.f7 db/f7" is not being processed correctly.
requirement.contract: Modify the HTTP client to properly sanitize and process path traversal sequences, ensuring that dotfiles are handled according to user permissions and access control rules.

requirement.description: The VFS initialization is not properly handling section headers and configuration validation. This leads to "invalid section header" errors in test_2.
requirement.contract: Ensure the VFS class properly validates section headers when loading configuration files, checking for valid section formats and proper structure.
